blog.title: Blog Index
blog.notes: Paginated list of 10 post cards (image, date, title, tags). Page 1 lives at /blog; later pages at /blog/page/N.

blog-playwright-mcp-extension-token.title: Blog Post
blog-playwright-mcp-extension-token.notes: Representative article. Each post has its own slug URL, so the id helper treats every post as a separate page; this one stands in for all. Has in-page TOC anchors, code blocks with 'Copy Text', related-post links, and a 'Get Started Free' CTA to /admin.

blog-page-id.title: Blog Index (Paginated)
blog-page-id.notes: Same layout as /blog plus a '← Previous' link. 7 pages observed.

tools.title: Free Tools Index
tools.notes: Card list of free tools; currently one tool (Browser test recorder).

tools-browser-test-recorder.title: Free Tool Detail (Browser Test Recorder)
tools-browser-test-recorder.notes: 'Add to Chrome' links out to the Chrome Web Store. FAQ uses <details>/<summary> accordions.

pricing.title: Pricing Page
pricing.notes: Plans: Pay as you go / Scale / Custom. 'Get Started' and 'Upgrade to Scale' lead to signup/purchase and were deliberately not exercised. FAQ uses button accordions.

contact.title: Contact Page
contact.notes: Book-a-demo (external Google Calendar), mailto link, and a Name/Email/Subject/Message form. 'Send Message' is disabled until all fields are filled. Form was never submitted.

features-plain-english-test-creation.title: Feature Detail Page
features-plain-english-test-creation.notes: One of 9 feature pages listed in the navbar Features mega-menu; each has its own slug. CTAs: 'Try Free Demo' (/#try-demo), 'View Pricing'.

home.title: Home / Landing Page
home.notes: Hero has a public demo widget: prompt textarea, Mode (Quick/Deep) and Agent selectors, example preset chips, 'Run Free Test' (3 anonymous runs, not exercised), 'See demo account' (enters a read-only demo of the app at /admin), 'Watch demo'.

admin.title: App Dashboard (Demo Account)
admin.notes: Reached without signup via 'See demo account' (/api/demo/enter sets a demo session). Read-only: create/delete/save controls are disabled. Banner offers 'Sign up free' and 'Exit demo'. Some API calls return 403 in demo mode.

admin-projects.title: Projects List
admin-projects.notes: Project cards with View link, env count, test plan count. New Project / Delete disabled in demo.

admin-projects-id.title: Project Detail
admin-projects-id.notes: Project name (disabled), Environments (view opens a modal dialog), Integrations (Linear/Jira/GitHub Issues).

admin-runs.title: Runs List
admin-runs.notes: Table of runs with clickable rows; search box writes ?search= to the URL; Filters button. Rows load asynchronously after the heading. Arriving from Builds adds ?build=<id> and a 'Build: <id>' filter chip with a 'Clear all' button.

admin-runs-id-results.title: Run Results Report
admin-runs-id-results.notes: Report: Prompt/Script toggle, criteria/steps/issues/screenshots anchors, expandable execution steps, Export (PDF/HTML/JSON/JUnit), attempt history links.

admin-test-plans.title: Test Plans List
admin-test-plans.notes: Search + Filters; 'New Test Plan' and 'Manage test data' disabled in demo.

docs.title: Documentation Index
docs.notes: Docs landing with a left sidebar of sections.

docs-test-plans.title: Docs Section Page
docs-test-plans.notes: Representative docs section; each section has its own slug.

admin-schedules.title: Schedules List
admin-schedules.notes: Table of cron schedules (name, cron + timezone, test plans/projects, last/next run, status, actions). Fully read-only in demo: every checkbox, status toggle and row action button is disabled and rows are not clickable, so there are no outgoing in-page actions.

admin-builds.title: Builds List
admin-builds.notes: Test runs grouped by build/commit id (25 per page, ~2.7k builds). 'Filters' reveals a searchable project picker (writes ?project=<id>); Previous/Next pagination writes ?page=N. Each row's 'View build <id>' link goes to /admin/runs?build=<id>.

admin-recordings.title: Recordings (Beta)
admin-recordings.notes: Lists flows captured with the Chrome extension's Record mode. In the demo it always shows the 'No recordings yet' empty state because GET /api/admin/recordings returns 403 for the demo session. Only link is 'Get the Chrome extension' (external Chrome Web Store, not followed).

admin-whats-new.title: What's New (Changelog)
admin-whats-new.notes: Dated changelog entries (New feature / Beta badges); each entry is a button that expands inline to show an image, description, a docs/blog link, and a feedback email.
